name: Selections From 'The Wolf House'
source:
[i]"The Wolf House" was the working title of an unpublished erotic horror-adventure game produced by now-defunct studio Pseudo Body Works between 2005 and 2009.

Inspired by games like Human's "Clock Tower" series, The Wolf House would have been a surreal, baroque adventure through an ornate mansion, pursued by a deranged, sexually voracious villainess and the servants at her beck and call.

This is a collection of production materials recovered from multiple sources across the internet, with the intent to preserve what remains of this project for interested audiences.[/i]

[From [url=https://pseudobody.itch.io/selections-from-the-wolf-house]itch.io[/url]]

A number of short chapters presented as the collected materials from an abandoned game.
